headers.comment: A stale service worker pins everyone to the old build. Browsers will happily serve sw.js from cache for up to 24 hours unless told not to, so this file must always be revalidated.

No build step means no content hashes in filenames, so app code cannot be cached immutably. Revalidate on every load and let the 304s keep it cheap. The service worker is what makes this fast offline, not the HTTP cache.
Scouting data is personal to the team and this is a public URL. Keep it out of search results and stop the browser leaking the referrer to The Blue Alliance and Statbotics.
